2607.12815.title: Visual Access Boundaries in Vision-Language Model Reasoning
2607.12815.paper_summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting is widely used as a test-time scaling strategy for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), but it remains unclear what is extended when VLMs generate longer reasoning traces. We ask whether CoT requires continued access to image tokens, or whether it mainly operates over visual information already made available earlier in the forward pass. We introduce Visual Access Sweep, a causal intervention that masks attention from generated-token queries to image-token keys along layer depth and generation time, and define the Visual Access Boundary (VAB) as the minimal access region that preserves task accuracy. Across six model configurations from Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3, both no-CoT direct answering and CoT prompting exhibit finite VABs. In Qwen2.5-VL-32B and InternVL3 at 14B and 38B scales, when CoT is evaluated against the no-CoT full-access target, its VAB layer differs from the no-CoT boundary by at most two layers, despite substantially longer generations. This suggests that CoT does not primarily improve performance by prolonging direct image-token access throughout the reasoning trace, but by extending language-side computation over image-derived hidden-state information. We further show that CoT gains are constrained by perceptual readout. CoT helps when the queried visual attribute can be reliably read out by the model, but not when that readout is unreliable. A symbolic-attribute oracle shows that CoT can improve counting once ground-truth attributes are supplied as text, while a single-object probe-vs-decode check shows that hard attributes can be linearly recoverable from hidden states yet difficult for the model itself to output. Together, these analyses place the bottleneck at readout rather than counting.
2607.12815.paper_summary_zh: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 提示被廣泛用作視覺語言模型（VLMs）的測試時間擴展策略，但目前尚不清楚當 VLMs 生成更長的推理痕跡時，擴展了什麼。我們詢問 CoT 是否需要持續訪問圖像標記，或者它主要是否基於在前向傳播中已經提供的視覺信息。我們引入了視覺訪問掃描（Visual Access Sweep），這是一種因果干預，通過在層深度和生成時間上遮蔽從生成標記查詢到圖像標記鍵的注意力，並將視覺訪問邊界（Visual Access Boundary, VAB）定義為保持任務準確性的最小訪問區域。在來自 Qwen2.5-VL 和 InternVL3 的六種模型配置中，無 CoT 的直接回答和 CoT 提示都顯示出有限的 VAB。在 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 和 InternVL3 的 14B 和 38B 比例下，當 CoT 與無 CoT 的全訪問目標進行評估時，其 VAB 層與無 CoT 邊界最多相差兩層，儘管生成過程顯著更長。這表明 CoT 主要不是通過延長直接圖像標記訪問來提高性能，而是通過擴展基於圖像衍生的隱藏狀態信息的語言側計算。我們進一步顯示 CoT 的增益受到感知讀出限制。當被查詢的視覺屬性可以被模型可靠地讀出時，CoT 有助於提升，但當該讀出不可靠時則無法。符號屬性神諭顯示，當提供真實屬性作為文本時，CoT 可以改善計數，而單一物體探針與解碼檢查顯示，硬屬性可以從隱藏狀態中線性恢復，但對模型本身來說卻難以輸出。綜合這些分析，瓶頸在於讀出而非計數。
